formula: x,y in [-1,1] on the tensor passed to the stem; r = hypot(x,y)/sqrt(2) in [0,1]
augmentation: Rotation, scale, and mirror run before the network. AddCoordinates rebuilds x,y,r from the current patch indices, so a mirrored tensor still has column 0 at -1.
conclusion: The numeric definition matches manuscript 3.4 for the tensor that enters the stem. Training uses a 512 crop of a median 750 image, and inference uses 4 sliding-window tiles. The origin is the current patch center, not a single frame locked to the catheter after an off-center crop.
